node.title: searching keywords
node.author: pdahal
node.doctext: I am trying to list the protein names listed in the PubMed abstracts. I made a file containing the list of proteins I want to search. The code is running well but I got a problem. For example, I have a got a protein name "NOV" in the keyword list. But even if the abstract doesn't contain NOV, it lists NOV if there are words like novel. How can I solve this problem?
